hypotheses.justification: Unfold Module.rankAtStalk and localize directly at p, avoiding local constancy. Since S is a domain, p.asIdeal.primeCompl ≤ nonZeroDivisors S: every element outside p is nonzero. IsLocalization.rank_eq followed by IsLocalizedModule.rank_eq identifies the localized rank with Module.rank S M. Then hrank and Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq prove the conclusion. These lemmas require neither finite presentation nor flatness, so both hypotheses can be removed together. The argument also covers n = 0 and the zero module.

The same direct localization argument works without flatness: Module.rankAtStalk is the finrank of the localized module, not its residue-field fiber dimension. IsLocalization.rank_eq and IsLocalizedModule.rank_eq preserve rank when the denominators are non-zero-divisors, as they are here. Apply hrank and Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq. This includes torsion modules and rank zero, and also permits removing finite presentation simultaneously.
